output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $199,864 to run Madison Park Upper Campus after-school program

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $199,864.00

output.summary: Under this memorandum of understanding (MOU), Bay Area Community Resources serves as lead agency for the after-school program at Madison Park Academy Upper Campus. It provides program coordination, math intervention, homework support, student supervision and enrichment. The term is August 1, 2019 through July 31, 2020, and the cost cannot exceed $199,864.

output.headline: Accepts $85,000 from Oakland's Fund for Children and Youth for Oakland International High School
output.summary: The district accepts $85,000 from the City of Oakland's KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth. The money supports on-campus wellness services, targeted help for high-risk youth, leadership training and restorative justice for more than 357 newly arrived immigrant high school students a year at Oakland International High School. The grant covers July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020.

vendor.name: City of Oakland - KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth

output.headline: Allows temporary borrowing of up to $30M from the Alameda County Treasury in 2019-20
output.summary: The Board adopts a resolution asking the Alameda County Treasury for a temporary transfer of funds of no more than $30 million. The text says this is because district revenue and receipts fluctuate during fiscal year 2019-2020. The text does not say how or when the funds would be repaid.

output.headline: Sets up temporary transfers between district funds for fiscal year 2019-20
output.summary: The Board adopts a resolution to establish temporary interfund transfers, meaning short-term moves of money between district funds, for fiscal year 2019-2020. The text gives no dollar amount.

output.headline: Pays FM3 Research up to $33,000 to survey voters on a possible 2020 school facilities bond

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $33,000.00

output.summary: FM3 Research of Oakland will conduct a public opinion survey of district voters on a potential 2020 General Obligation Bond to modernize district facilities. The agreement runs from August 29, 2019 through June 30, 2020, and the cost cannot exceed $33,000.

vendor.name: FM3 Research (Fairbank, Maslin, Maullin, Metz and Associates)

output.headline: Sets rent for the district's 1000 Broadway offices at about $236K to $251K a month through 2022
output.sourceIssueCandidate: Two monthly rent figures are printed with a stray space after the comma ($236, 304.80 and $250, 695.76); no total contract cost is stated.
output.summary: This fourth amendment to the office lease with Sparknight, LLC sets monthly base rent for the central administrative offices at 1000 Broadway. Rent is $236,304.80 a month from September 2019, $243,393.94 from September 2020 and $250,695.76 from September 2021, through August 31, 2022. The district also pays its share of increases in taxes and operating expenses starting January 1, 2020. The text does not state a total.

output.headline: Approves a new or revised job description for Truck Driver
output.summary: The Board adopts a resolution creating or revising the district's job description for the Truck Driver position. The text gives no dollar amount.

output.headline: Adds $5,000 for Siegfried Engineering's extra Westlake Middle School field design work
output.summary: This amendment adds design services for an additional basketball court retrofit, a drinking fountain, court striping and painting of seat walls at the Westlake Middle School Field Project. It adds $5,000 and raises the agreement's cap from $85,902.68 to $90,902.68.

output.headline: Partners with Academy of Art University for art-teacher student teaching, at no cost, to 2022
output.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Academy of Art University's School of Education in San Francisco sets up a practica program, meaning supervised classroom placements, for K-12 teaching in single subject and designated subject art education. It runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022 and costs the district nothing.

vendor.name: Academy of Art University, School of Education

output.headline: Partners with Saint Mary's College on teacher and counselor training programs at no cost to 2022
output.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Saint Mary's College of California in Moraga covers an intern partnership program, student teaching placements, and internships for school counselors, clinical educational therapists, clinical school psychologists and administrators. It also covers practica and immersive experiences for undergraduates working toward a credential. It runs July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022 at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Partners with Trellis Education on a two-year STEM teacher pathway funded by a state residency grant
output.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Trellis Education covers the STEM Teacher Pathway and Mentor Fellow Project for July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2021. The district would pass through money from a California teacher credentialing residency grant, with fiscal oversight under the grant award agreement. The text does not state a dollar amount.

output.headline: Pays Peralta Community College District up to $419,584 to run Gateway to College at Laney in 2019-20

money.evidence: in an ADA amount not to exceed $419,583.72

output.summary: Peralta Community College District will operate Gateway to College at Laney Alternative High School, the district's alternative high school on the Laney College campus. The agreement runs July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The limit of $419,583.72 is described as an attendance-based (ADA) amount.

output.headline: Renews UC Berkeley teacher-training partnership for 2019-20 at no district cost
output.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the Regents of the University of California, through UC Berkeley's Graduate School of Education, covers intern partnership and practica programs, meaning supervised placements, for K-12 teaching and other school credentials. It runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, with no district funding and no fiscal oversight.

vendor.name: Regents of the University of California, UC Berkeley Graduate School of Education

output.headline: Adopts Personnel Report No. 1920-0002 from the Talent/Human Resources Department
output.summary: The Board adopts the district's Personnel Report No. 1920-0002. The agenda text does not list the individual personnel actions or any dollar amounts.

output.headline: Adopts the Board's meeting agenda calendar for August 2019 through June 2020 (second reading)
output.summary: The Board adopts its calendar of agenda items for meetings from August 2019 through June 2020. It also lets the Board President make further adjustments to the calendar unless the Board decides otherwise.

output.headline: Creates job descriptions for Position Control Analyst and Senior Executive Director, Accounting
output.summary: The Board adopts a resolution creating district job descriptions for two positions: Analyst, Position Control and Senior Executive Director, Accounting. The text gives no dollar amount.

output.headline: Ratifies the Board President's appointment of a new member to the 7-11 Committee
output.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointment of a new member to the 7-11 Committee, starting August 29, 2019. The member succeeds a previous member and serves the unexpired term, which ends April 14, 2021.
